class.name: NetwPropertySetColumn
class.description: The name, type and quantizer come from the [NetwSchema] column at [member schema_column]. The rest says how the property is sent and corrected. Most members are set by [NetwPropertyConfig].

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a column for a set built by hand, with no [NetwSchema].

members.member: Whether the value is sent as a change from the last value the peer confirmed, or in full. [constant DELTA_AUTO] sends changes only for a quantized value wider than eight bits in a [constant NetwPropertySet.RECORD_STATE] set, and never for a [NetwQuantizeAngle]. Values narrower than five bits are always sent in full.
Set by [method NetwPropertyConfig.epsilon]. Negative uses the entity's default.
A [enum NetwPropertySet.Lane]. The same as [member watch].
A [enum NetwPropertySet.PropertyClass], which decides whether a difference causes a correction.
How the value is compressed, or [code]null[/code] to send it as is.
The index of this property in its [NetwSchema].
Set by [method NetwPropertyConfig.teleport_at]. Negative uses the entity's default.
The column type in the schema.
[code]true[/code] sends the value reliably when it changes. [code]false[/code] sends it unreliably.

constants.constant: Chosen from the declaration. See [member delta_mode].
Send the change from the last confirmed value when it is smaller.
